answers.project_description: GenAI-powered Urban Air Quality & Winter Smog Copilot for Families and Communities
answers.problem_statement: Families and communities struggle to navigate catastrophic winter smog and thermal inversions without actionable, low-emission routines, low-cost indoor hacks, or quantifiable health/emission impact metrics.
answers.target_users: Urban families with children/infants, sensitive individuals (asthma/elderly), daily commuters, and neighborhood community leaders.
answers.ai_engine: Google Gemini API + Grounded Local Smog Intelligence Engine
answers.tdd_strictness: Moderate - Unit tests for algorithms, impact math, and core UI components
